observations.text: Signage reads 'SERVICE BAY 2' hanging from or mounted on the wall above the bay.
Graphic illustration/vector art depicting an auto repair service bay with a vehicle on a lift rather than a real photographic image.
Red tool cabinet or chest on the left side of the bay.
Stack of spare tires/wheels depicted on the right side.
Watermark or disclaimer text at bottom right reads 'SYNTHETIC · FOR DEMO'.
